hypotheses.justification: Write J x = (fderiv ℝ f x).normDet and r = s ∩ {x | J x ≠ 0}. By IntegrableOn.mono_set, J is integrable on r. IntegrableOn.restrict_toMeasurable then shows that it remains integrable on the measurable hull t = toMeasurable volume r. Apply ae_summable_fiber on t with constant weight 1 and the existing finite-fiber argument. Meanwhile, hf.euclideanHausdorffMeasure_image_setOf_normDet_fderiv_eq_zero says that f '' {x | J x = 0} is null. Outside this image, every point of the fiber in s belongs to r, hence to t, so that fiber is finite. This argument also covers empty sets and zero-dimensional spaces without extra assumptions.
